content.title: Lululemon founder launches proxy fight
content.description:
Lululemon (LULU) shares closed 1.7% higher on Monday on news that the company's founder, Chip Wilson, is launching a proxy fight. Wilson has nominated three director candidates to the company's board as the fitness apparel company searches for a new CEO. Yahoo Finance Senior Reporter Brooke DiPalma reports the latest.

content.title: Lululemon Founder Chip Wilson Launches Proxy Battle
content.summary: Lululemon  Athletica’s founder Chip Wilson is launching a proxy fight at the activewear retailer in a bid to remake the company’s board of directors.  Wilson has nominated three candidates to Lululemon’s board: Marc Maurer, former co-CEO of On Running; Laura Gentile, former chief marketing officer at ESPN; and Eric Hirshberg, former CEO of Activision.  The Wall Street Journal reported the fight earlier.
